pages.text: Vael's raiment of midnight cloth and Moonsilver: a crescent circlet, a mantle embroidered with stars and three small moons that circle behind you.$(br2)Worn whole, it grants $(l)Night Vision$() and $(l)Speed$() after dusk, and halves the bite of every fall.
Lunar Mantle. Catalyst: an iron chestplate; offerings: four Moonsilver ingots, wool and a phantom membrane; 800 Luna light. The other pieces ask for wool, phantom membranes and feathers.
